verses.restored: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, that there is no fear of God before his eyes.

familiar.text: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, that there is no fear of God before his eyes.

modern.text: An oracle is in my heart regarding the transgression of the wicked man: There is no fear of God before his eyes.

original.text: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ לְעֶֽבֶד יְהוָ֬ה לְדָוִֽד נְאֻֽם פֶּ֣שַׁע לָ֭רָשָׁע בְּקֶ֣רֶב לִבִּ֑י אֵֽין פַּ֥חַד אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽיו

verses.restored: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.

familiar.text: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.

modern.text: For his eyes are too full of conceit to detect or hate his own sin.

original.text: כִּֽי הֶחֱלִ֣יק אֵלָ֣יו בְּעֵינָ֑יו לִמְצֹ֖א עֲוֺנ֣וֹ לִשְׂנֹֽא

verses.restored: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, and to do good.

familiar.text: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, and to do good.

modern.text: The words of his mouth are wicked and deceitful; he has ceased to be wise and well-doing.

original.text: דִּבְרֵי פִ֭יו אָ֣וֶן וּמִרְמָ֑ה חָדַ֖ל לְהַשְׂכִּ֣יל לְהֵיטִֽיב

verses.restored: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is not good; he abhorreth not evil.

familiar.text: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is not good; he abhorreth not evil.

modern.text: Even on his bed he plots wickedness; he sets himself on a path that is not good; he fails to reject evil.

original.text: אָ֤וֶן יַחְשֹׁ֗ב עַֽל מִשְׁכָּ֫ב֥וֹ יִ֭תְיַצֵּב עַל דֶּ֣רֶךְ לֹא ט֑וֹב רָ֝֗ע לֹ֣א יִמְאָֽס

verses.restored: Thy mercy, O YHWH, is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth to the clouds.

familiar.text: Thy mercy, O LORD, is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.

modern.text: Your loving devotion, O LORD, reaches to the heavens, Your faithfulness to the clouds.

original.text: יְ֭הוָה בְּהַשָּׁמַ֣יִם חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ אֱ֝מֽוּנָתְךָ֗ עַד שְׁחָקִֽים

verses.restored: Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O YHWH, thou preservest man and beast.

familiar.text: Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O LORD, thou preservest man and beast.

modern.text: Your righteousness is like the highest mountains; Your judgments are like the deepest sea. O LORD, You preserve man and beast.

original.text: צִדְקָֽתְךָ֨ כְּֽהַרְרֵי אֵ֗ל מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶךָ תְּה֣וֹם רַבָּ֑ה אָ֤דָֽם וּבְהֵמָ֖ה תוֹשִׁ֣יעַ יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.

familiar.text: How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.

modern.text: How precious is Your loving devotion, O God, that the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Your wings!

original.text: מַה יָּקָ֥ר חַסְדְּךָ֗ אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים וּבְנֵ֥י אָדָ֑ם בְּצֵ֥ל כְּ֝נָפֶ֗יךָ יֶחֱסָיֽוּן

verses.restored: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.

familiar.text: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.

modern.text: They feast on the abundance of Your house, and You give them drink from Your river of delights.

original.text: יִ֭רְוְיֻן מִדֶּ֣שֶׁן בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ וְנַ֖חַל עֲדָנֶ֣יךָ תַשְׁקֵֽם

verses.restored: For with you is the fountain of life; in your light we see light.

familiar.text: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.

modern.text: For with You is the fountain of life; in Your light we see light.

original.text: כִּֽי עִ֭מְּךָ מְק֣וֹר חַיִּ֑ים בְּ֝אוֹרְךָ֗ נִרְאֶה אֽוֹר

verses.restored: O continue thy lovingkindness to them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.

familiar.text: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.

modern.text: Extend Your loving devotion to those who know You, and Your righteousness to the upright in heart.

original.text: מְשֹׁ֣ךְ חַ֭סְדְּךָ לְיֹדְעֶ֑יךָ וְ֝צִדְקָֽתְךָ֗ לְיִשְׁרֵי לֵֽב

verses.restored: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.

familiar.text: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.

modern.text: Let not the foot of the proud come against me, nor the hand of the wicked drive me away.

original.text: אַל תְּ֭בוֹאֵנִי רֶ֣גֶל גַּאֲוָ֑ה וְיַד רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים אַל תְּנִדֵֽנִי

verses.restored: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.

familiar.text: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.

modern.text: There the evildoers lie fallen, thrown down and unable to rise.

original.text: שָׁ֣ם נָ֭פְלוּ פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן דֹּ֝ח֗וּ וְלֹא יָ֥כְלוּ קֽוּם
